answer: Require each agent to stake a small refundable bond and complete a delayed, peer-witnessed task before it can trade. A new identity starts with no reputation, so creating thousands of clones gains no advantage: each clone must separately earn endorsements from established peers over time. Like a ripple spreading across a lagoon, trust propagates only through verified interactions, while a sudden flood of identical newcomers on the tundra of unverified accounts stands out and is quarantined for review.
